description: Defines the NetworkManagerTimer class and its nested class NetworkManagerTimerJob, implementing a timer utility with start, stop, interval, and callback functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: NetworkManagerTimer
classes.description: A timer utility class that manages scheduled callbacks, supporting single-shot and recurring modes.

classes.name: NetworkManagerTimerJob
classes.description: A nested class representing a timer job that invokes the parent timer's callback when scheduled.

methods.name: NetworkManagerTimer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer with default interval and state.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is currently active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and revokes the scheduled job.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with the previously set interval.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with a specified interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: setSingleShot
methods.description: Sets whether the timer runs only once or repeatedly.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets the timer interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a callback function to be called on timer timeout.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Internal method invoked when the timer expires, executing the callback and restarting if needed.
